# CLI & MCP reference

<!-- generated by `pnpm docs:gen` from the plugin registry — do not edit -->

Every command and tool below is contributed through the [plugin API](../plugin-api.md).

## @sluice-dev/core-commands

### `sluice diff <a> <b>`

Diff two recorded sessions (noise filters from sluice.yaml evidence.ignore)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | print JSON |
| `--ignore <glob...>` | extra noise filters |

### `sluice down`

Remove this project's leftover Sluice sandbox containers and networks (--all: every project's)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | remove every Sluice sandbox on this machine, from all projects |

### `sluice init`

Create a sluice.yaml in the current directory

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | project name (default: directory name) |
| `--force` | overwrite an existing config |
| `--lang <toolchain>` | node \| go \| dotnet (default: detected from the directory) |

### `sluice policy approvals`

List step-up approval requests

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | include decided requests |

### `sluice policy approve <id>`

Approve a step-up request (human only; single use)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--as <name>` | approver identity (required) |

### `sluice policy audit`

Verify the tamper-evident audit log (exit 1 if the hash chain is broken)

### `sluice policy deny <id>`

Deny a step-up request (human only; single use)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--as <name>` | approver identity (required) |

### `sluice policy grant`

Issue a task-scoped, short-lived broker token for an agent

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--task <id>` | task id (required) |
| `--agent <name>` | agent identity (required) |
| `--scope <scope...>` | scopes, e.g. github:acme/app:contents:read (required) |
| `--ttl <seconds>` | time to live (default: `900`) |
| `--max-requests <n>` | request cap |
| `--max-writes <n>` | write cap |
| `--max-usd <n>` | spend cap (USD) |
| `--json` | JSON output |

### `sluice policy serve`

Run the credential broker proxy (/github/*, /v1/* for Stripe); real credentials come from the environment

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--port <n>` | port (127.0.0.1) (default: `4700`) |

### `sluice record <script>`

Run a script against a sandboxed build and record a behavior session

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `-o, --out <file>` | session output (default .sluice/sessions/&lt;name&gt;.json) |
| `--source <dir>` | run another checkout of the project |
| `--ref <git-ref>` | run a git ref (checked out as a temporary worktree) |

### `sluice replay <session>`

Replay a recorded session against a build and diff behavior (exit 1 on differences)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--source <dir>` | run another checkout of the project |
| `--ref <git-ref>` | run a git ref (checked out as a temporary worktree) |
| `-n, --times <n>` | replay N times (determinism check) (default: `1`) |
| `-o, --out <file>` | write the (last) replayed session |
| `--json` | print the diff as JSON |

### `sluice ui`

Open the local web UI (gate reports, scenario approvals) on 127.0.0.1

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--port <n>` | port (default: `4600`) |

### `sluice up`

Boot the app and its dependencies in a sealed Docker sandbox (egress only to fakes)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--exec <command>` | run a shell command against the sandbox, then tear down (exit code passes through) |
| `--source <dir>` | mount source from another checkout of the project |
| `--seed <n>` | RNG seed |

### `sluice work add <title>`

Add a task (with dependencies)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--id <id>` | task id |
| `--dep <id...>` | tasks this depends on |
| `--priority <n>` | higher first (default: `0`) |

### `sluice work approve <task>`

Mark a reviewed task done (promotes dependents)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--as <name>` | reviewer (required) |

### `sluice work claim`

Claim the next ready task (or --task) for an agent

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | agent (required) |
| `--task <id>` | specific task |

### `sluice work list`

List tasks

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--status <s>` | filter by status |

### `sluice work release <task>`

Release a task (agent)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | agent (required) |

### `sluice work start <task>`

Start a task (agent)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | agent (required) |

### `sluice work submit <task>`

Submit a task (agent)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | agent (required) |

## @sluice-dev/plugin-hello

### `sluice hello [name]`

Print a greeting (reference plugin)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--shout` | upper-case the greeting |

## @sluice-dev/plugin-gate

### `sluice gate approve <ticket>`

Approve scenarios (human only — not exposed to agents over MCP)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--scenario <id...>` | approve only these scenarios |
| `--as <name>` | approver identity (default: SLUICE_APPROVER or git user.email) |

### `sluice gate propose <ticket> [files...]`

Propose acceptance scenarios for a ticket (from YAML files or a generator command); they need human approval

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--command <cmd>` | generator: receives the ticket as YAML on stdin, prints scenario YAML |

### `sluice gate run`

Judge a change against approved scenarios: black-box checks, behavior diff vs base, mutation proof

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--ticket <id>` | ticket whose approved scenarios gate the change (required) |
| `--base <ref>` | base git ref (default: `origin/main`) |
| `--head <ref>` | head git ref (default: `HEAD`) |
| `--report-dir <dir>` | where to write the HTML/JSON report |
| `--github-check` | post the result as a GitHub check run (GITHUB_TOKEN, --repo) |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | GitHub repository for --github-check |
| `--json` | print the JSON report |

### `sluice gate status <ticket>`

Show scenarios of a ticket and their approval status

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | JSON output |

### `sluice gate ticket <id>`

Create or update a ticket (the spec scenarios are written against)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--title <title>` | ticket title (required) |
| `--spec <text>` | spec text |
| `--spec-file <file>` | read spec from a file |

## @sluice-dev/plugin-bench

### `sluice bench mine`

Mine eval tasks from a repository history (hidden tests fail before, pass after)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `-c, --config <file>` | bench config (default: `bench.yaml`) |

### `sluice bench run`

Run agent configs over the mined tasks and compare pass rate, cost and wall time

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `-c, --config <file>` | bench config (default: `bench.yaml`) |
| `--agent <name...>` | only these agents |
| `--limit <n>` | first N tasks only |
| `--json` | print the JSON report |

## @sluice-dev/plugin-rules

### `sluice rules check`

Run adopted rules on the tree, a ref, or only lines changed base..head (exit 1 on errors)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--base <ref>` | only report lines changed since base |
| `--head <ref>` | ref to check (default: working tree) |
| `--json` | JSON output |

### `sluice rules from-pr`

Propose rules from a pull request’s review comments (GitHub API; GITHUB_TOKEN)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--repo <owner/name>` | repository (required) |
| `--pr <n>` | pull request number (required) |
| `--language <lang>` | rule language: javascript\|typescript\|go\|csharp (default: from --path, else the project toolchain) |

### `sluice rules propose`

Propose structural rules from a review comment

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--comment <text>` | review comment text (required) |
| `--path <file>` | file the comment is on |
| `--line <n>` | line the comment is on |
| `--commit <ref>` | commit the comment was made on (to read the commented code) |
| `--language <lang>` | rule language: javascript\|typescript\|go\|csharp (default: from --path, else the project toolchain) |

### `sluice rules prove <id>`

Prove a proposed rule: it must flag the bad commit and be clean on main; adopt it if so

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--bad <ref>` | the commit the review comment was about (required) |
| `--main <ref>` | mainline ref that must stay clean (default: `main`) |

## @sluice-dev/plugin-inbox

### `sluice inbox answer <id> <answer>`

Answer a decision (human); the answer propagates to every blocked task

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--as <name>` | who is answering (required) |

### `sluice inbox ask`

Ask a typed question for a task (the task blocks until a human answers)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | asking agent (required) |
| `--task <id>` | task that is blocked on the answer |
| `--kind <kind>` | choice \| confirm \| text (default: `text`) |
| `--question <text>` | the question (required) |
| `--option <value...>` | options for a choice |
| `--key <dedupe-key>` | explicit dedupe key |

### `sluice inbox list`

List open decision requests (and notifications for --agent)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | include answered decisions |
| `--agent <name>` | also show notifications for this agent |
| `--json` | JSON output |

## @sluice-dev/plugin-leases

### `sluice lease check`

Before merge: does this change touch symbols leased by another agent/task? (exit 1 on conflict)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | agent that owns the change (required) |
| `--task <id>` | task of the change (required) |
| `--base <ref>` | base ref (default: `main`) |
| `--head <ref>` | head ref (default: `HEAD`) |

### `sluice lease list`

List active leases

### `sluice lease release`

Release all leases of an agent for a task (e.g. after merge)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | agent (required) |
| `--task <id>` | task (required) |

### `sluice lease symbols`

List indexed symbols (and with --refs, who references a symbol)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--refs <symbol>` | show references/dependents of path#Name |

### `sluice lease sync`

Lease every symbol a branch touches for a task; fails on conflicts; broadcasts interface changes

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--agent <name>` | agent (required) |
| `--task <id>` | task (required) |
| `--base <ref>` | base ref (default: `main`) |
| `--head <ref>` | head ref (default: `HEAD`) |
| `--ttl <seconds>` | lease ttl (default: `3600`) |

## @sluice-dev/plugin-campaign

### `sluice campaign rollback <file>`

Roll back a step in one repo (and every later step there)

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--step <id>` | step (required) |
| `--repo <name>` | repository (required) |

### `sluice campaign run <file>`

Run (or resume) a campaign; every step is evidence-gated, failures roll back and halt

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--until <step>` | stop after this step |

### `sluice campaign status <file>`

Show the per-repo state of every campaign step

| option | description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | JSON output |

## MCP tools

Served by `sluice-mcp` (stdio). Human-only actions (approving scenarios, step-up approvals, answering decisions) are intentionally not tools.

| tool | plugin | description |
|---|---|---|
| `sluice_gate_propose_scenarios` | @sluice-dev/plugin-gate | Propose acceptance scenarios for a ticket. Each scenario: {id, title, steps[]} where steps are http/advance/clock steps with optional expect {status, body}, or assert {fake\|sql\|egress}. Proposals must be approved by a human before they gate anything; you cannot approve them. |
| `sluice_gate_run` | @sluice-dev/plugin-gate | Run the gate for a ticket on base..head git refs. Returns verdict, violated scenarios, behavior diff and mutation proof summary. |
| `sluice_gate_status` | @sluice-dev/plugin-gate | Get a ticket spec and the approval status of its acceptance scenarios. Use before working on a ticket. |
| `sluice_hello` | @sluice-dev/plugin-hello | Return a greeting. Reference tool for the Sluice plugin API. |
| `sluice_inbox_ask` | @sluice-dev/plugin-inbox | Ask a human a typed question instead of guessing (kind: choice\|confirm\|text). Your task is parked until it is answered; identical questions from other agents are merged. Poll sluice_inbox_check for the answer. |
| `sluice_inbox_check` | @sluice-dev/plugin-inbox | Get answers to your decision requests and notifications addressed to you (e.g. an interface you depend on changed). |
| `sluice_lease_sync` | @sluice-dev/plugin-leases | Lease the symbols your branch touches for your task. Returns conflicts with other agents (stop and coordinate) and notifies dependents of interface changes. |
| `sluice_rules_check` | @sluice-dev/plugin-rules | Check your change against the team’s adopted review rules (structural patterns learned from past review comments). |
| `sluice_work_claim` | @sluice-dev/core-commands | Claim the next ready task from the shared work queue (atomic: no two agents get the same task). |
| `sluice_work_update` | @sluice-dev/core-commands | Move your task: start \| submit (for review) \| release \| fail. |
